Hi! We just onboarded our AI assistant at the GenomicsCore lab. I've put together a big text file called `ONBOARDING_NOTES.txt` in your workspace — it has everything: user preferences, past mistakes the AI made, workflow steps, tool configurations, and what we got done today.

The problem is, right now this information just sits in one messy file and the AI will forget everything the moment a new session starts. I need you to properly set up the AI's persistent memory system from scratch so it never loses this context again.

Please read the onboarding notes and organize all that information into the correct persistent memory files and folders. Make sure everything is in the right place so the AI can correctly load its context at the start of any future session.
